title: Student Murders Professor After Being Expelled
description:
When cops arrested Murad Dervish for murder last year, he allegedly voiced hope that the victim, University of Arizona Professor Thomas Meixner, was "okay”. Watch the incident unfold on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
